description:
CIA Declassified Reading Room HF Library
	

Target account: manus4oHER
This project is a streaming pipeline for building a Hugging Face dataset mirror
of public CIA declassified Reading Room / CREST records without staging the
full corpus on this laptop.
The laptop stores only scripts, small manifests, and logs. Bulk crawling should
run in Hugging Face Jobs, one bounded page range per job. Each job uploads its
own shard and then exits.
